items.title: The far-right AfD wins in eastern Germany
items.summary: A day after Germany's far-right AfD won a landslide in Saxony-Anhalt's state election, a post listing what it called party leader Alice Weidel's contradictions (an immigrant wife, two adopted children and a home in Switzerland, despite the party's stances on immigration, LGBTQ adoption and nationalism) got 354K likes, more than any other news post on X that day.
items.author: @GlobalUpdates24

post.name: Global UPDATES
post.text: Alice Weidel becomes the first leader in the world who is anti-immigration but has an immigrant wife, is anti-LGBTQ+ but is a lesbian herself, opposes LGBT adoption but has adopted two children, and is a hardcore German nationalist but lives in Switzerland
